## Body

Reviewer330 BLOCK at1c998e7 (04a96ae). The real adapter uses tmux3.6a argv transport, whose16KiB message ceiling is tighter than OS ARG_MAX. A minimum-width300-entry command list (one owned pane repeated to avoid300 processes; distinct IDs only enlarge it) produced34 failed launches in2.053s with pipe/marker/sink retained. A remain-on-exit retained dead middle pane produced46 launches in2.049s and starved a later LIVE tap. Verification retained the failing head plus untouched suffix, so unchanged retries made no progress. Keep packet-capacity and permanent-command-failure probes beside healthy batch proof; a true removed pane and an exited listed pane are different states. The actual Daemon.shutdown wiring was checked with a recording fake: detach precedes release normally; observer joined-task panic returns an error but still releases. D1 per-pane, D2 no abort, D3 raw rendering each independently failed its intended oracle; defaults passed. Distinguish convergence grace from hard child timeout and started blocking work from cancellable phase ownership. Regression source is retained as pr330-regression-tests.rs beside the session receipts. MagicWand: keep these negative production-adapter witnesses in the suite, under a real Tokio runtime, not only a healthy32-pane lightweight-executor test. Performance supplemental BLOCK da449fe confirms the same counts; deploy AFTER remains owed. Round2 checks fixes and main reconciliation only.
